Description: The Pod requires scheduling, but conflicts or unsatisfiable constraints exist.
The nodeSelector restricts scheduling to node1, but required labels are missing or the node does not satisfy the selector.
The Pod is strictly bound to nodeName=node1, but node1 is unavailable or cannot host the Pod.
The target Node has taints, but the Pod does not define corresponding tolerations, resulting in scheduling failure.
NodeAffinity constraints explicitly select node1, but resource or condition requirements cannot be satisfied.
The Pod requires co-scheduling with specific Pods, but the node cannot accommodate them.
Replica Pods are restricted by anti-affinity rules, preventing deployment on the same node.
Insufficient CPU resources on node1 prevent Pod scheduling.
Memory resources on the node are insufficient to schedule the Pod.
The number of Pods on the node has reached the maximum allowed limit.
The specified HostPort is already in use or conflicts with another Pod.
The specified PersistentVolumeClaim does not exist or cannot be bound.
The StorageClass is missing or does not support dynamic provisioning.

Secondary Category / Subclass: V3 Dynamic or Static Provisioning Unsatisfied
Description: Neither static provisioning nor dynamic provisioning requirements can be satisfied.
The PersistentVolume access mode (RWO/RWX) is incompatible with the PersistentVolumeClaim.
The PersistentVolume VolumeMode does not match the PVC expectation (Filesystem or Block).
The PersistentVolume capacity is smaller than the requested PVC storage size, causing binding failure.
The PersistentVolume explicitly referenced by the PVC does not exist or is already bound.
